animations.title: Walking
animations.action: Eight-frame walking-in-place cycle. Near-front, far-hind, far-front, near-hind contact on frames 1, 3, 5, 7 respectively; each paw has five stance phases followed by lift, swing and reach. Both golden hind paws bend, lift, swing forward and push backward. Stable torso/head/tail design for consistent leg review.
animations.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: an eight-frame retro pixel character animation sprite sheet, for extraction into individual frames and an animated GIF.
Reference image: supplied official character 01e is the strict identity and art-style reference. Animate this same creature; do not redesign it.
Character invariants: ONE shared golden quadruped body; exactly THREE attached heads: small orange Pomeranian on viewer LEFT, larger golden dog with dark-brown muzzle in MIDDLE, brown-charcoal striped tabby cat on RIGHT. Exactly FOUR legs: BOTH front legs and paws brown-charcoal striped cat legs, BOTH hind legs golden dog legs. Exactly THREE distinct attached tails: golden swept dog tail, orange/cream curled Pom plume, fluffy striped dark cat tail. Preserve all heads and tails in EVERY frame, no collars or accessories, same coat colors and thick dark-brown stepped outlines as 01e.
Style: coarse crisp retro pixel clusters, flat natural coat colors with sparse single-tone shadows, tiny square eyes and simple pixel mouths, no gradients, no smooth curves, no fur texture.
SHEET LAYOUT CRITICAL: landscape 2048x1024 PNG, EXACTLY FOUR COLUMNS and TWO ROWS, EIGHT evenly sized 512x512 square cells in a strict invisible grid. Reading order left to right on top row frames 1-4, then left to right bottom row frames 5-8. No drawn grid, no borders, NO captions, NO labels, NO text, no watermark. Each cell contains one complete frame. Maintain the same camera, character size, torso anchor and ground baseline across all eight cells; no zoom, rotation of camera, or sliding across the frame. Each sprite INCLUDING props fits entirely inside its own cell with generous clear margin and never touches cell boundaries. Approximately 75% cell width for character plus props. Transparent alpha background, no scenery, no floor, no shadow. Preserve cream fur opaque.
Action: eight-frame seamless WALK-IN-PLACE cycle facing left in the same three-quarter view as 01e. Show real alternating leg articulation: 1 left front paw forward/right front back, 2 contact, 3 pass under torso, 4 opposite front paw lifts, 5 opposite forward contact, 6 contact, 7 pass, 8 returning to frame 1. Hind legs alternate appropriately in a quadruped walking gait. Torso has only a tiny up/down bob; three heads stay recognizable and gently bob, three tails sway slightly. No props. End pose connects naturally to first pose. Full-body standing, not sitting.

animations.title: Sitting idle
animations.action: Action: eight-frame gentle SITTING IDLE loop. Creature sits on golden haunches in same three-quarter view, both tabby front legs vertical and both paws planted, golden hind legs folded naturally. Three tails spread visibly behind to the right. Frame 1 calm sitting eyes open; 2 slight inhale chest rises; 3 one tiny ear twitch; 4 eyelids half down; 5 all three blink closed; 6 eyes reopen; 7 slight exhale and gentle tail sway; 8 returns to calm pose. Barely perceptible body movement, stable paws and torso anchor. No props. The creature is sitting in ALL eight frames; no standing or walking. Seamless loop.

animations.title: Tennis ball
animations.action: Action: eight-frame vignette in SITTING pose: a small lime-green TENNIS BALL with one cream curved seam bounces at lower LEFT, distracting ONLY THE TWO DOG HEADS. The cat stays composed looking forward, unchanged eyes and face throughout. 1 seated creature calm, tennis ball near lower left; 2 ball rises, Pom notices and turns gaze left; 3 ball higher, both dogs perk their ears and turn their muzzles/gaze toward ball; 4 both dog heads track ball upward excitedly; 5 ball descends, both dogs lean slightly left watching; 6 ball reaches floor, Pom tilts and larger dog opens mouth slightly; 7 ball rebounds gently and dog heads track it; 8 ball low and heads return toward pose 1. One single connected body stays planted; no chasing, no extra animals. Show a genuinely changing ball position and dog head/ear poses, cat remains disinterested. Exactly ONE ball in each frame. Natural return to frame 1.
animations.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: an eight-frame retro pixel character animation sprite sheet, for extraction into individual frames and an animated GIF.
Reference image: supplied official character 01e is the strict identity and art-style reference. Animate this same creature; do not redesign it.
Character invariants: ONE shared golden quadruped body; exactly THREE attached heads: small orange Pomeranian on viewer LEFT, larger golden dog with dark-brown muzzle in MIDDLE, brown-charcoal striped tabby cat on RIGHT. Exactly FOUR legs: BOTH front legs and paws brown-charcoal striped cat legs, BOTH hind legs golden dog legs. Exactly THREE distinct attached tails: golden swept dog tail, orange/cream curled Pom plume, fluffy striped dark cat tail. Preserve all heads and tails in EVERY frame, no collars or accessories, same coat colors and thick dark-brown stepped outlines as 01e.
Style: coarse crisp retro pixel clusters, flat natural coat colors with sparse single-tone shadows, tiny square eyes and simple pixel mouths, no gradients, no smooth curves, no fur texture.
SHEET LAYOUT CRITICAL: landscape 2048x1024 PNG, EXACTLY FOUR COLUMNS and TWO ROWS, EIGHT evenly sized 512x512 square cells in a strict invisible grid. Reading order left to right on top row frames 1-4, then left to right bottom row frames 5-8. No drawn grid, no borders, NO captions, NO labels, NO text, no watermark. Each cell contains one complete frame. Maintain the same camera, character size, torso anchor and ground baseline across all eight cells; no zoom, rotation of camera, or sliding across the frame. Each sprite INCLUDING props fits entirely inside its own cell with generous clear margin and never touches cell boundaries. Approximately 75% cell width for character plus props. Transparent alpha background, no scenery, no floor, no shadow. Preserve cream fur opaque.

animations.title: Yarn ball

Both dog heads remain relaxed looking forward. 1 calm seated creature and yarn ball beside right front paw; 2 ball rolls right, cat notices and turns eyes toward it; 3 cat tilts its head down/right, ears forward; 4 cat leans head toward ball while both dogs stay still; 5 closest TABBY FRONT PAW lifts to gently bat the yarn ball; 6 paw touches ball and ball rolls farther right with trailing strand; 7 paw settles and cat tracks rolling ball; 8 yarn rolls back slightly and cat eases to initial gaze. Same shared body and all three heads/tails remain connected, golden hind legs folded. Exactly ONE yarn ball per cell, no new cat or separate body. Keep the ball within the frame. Loop returning naturally to pose 1.

animations.title: Food can
animations.action: Action: eight-frame narrative in SITTING pose, an unbranded silver pull-tab PET FOOD CAN opens in front of the creature and ALL THREE HEADS react with delight. Frame 1 sealed can on ground in front, three heads calmly seated; 2 pull-tab lifts slightly; 3 lid starts peeling up; 4 lid hinges open revealing brown pet food; 5 all three heads notice, ears perk, eyes brighten and lean toward the open can; 6 all three have cheerful small open mouths and closed smiling pixel eyes, three tails wag; 7 all three bounce their heads gently with delight, tails wag opposite way; 8 hold content happy pose with open food can. ALL THREE pets visibly react together, including cat, no unchanged indifferent face. One small can only, lid remains attached, no hands, no person, no written can label, no floating hearts or sparkles, no sound-effect text. Keep body size/anchor and can location stable. This is a start-to-finish opening sequence, not a seamless loop; do not close the can at the end.
